objective:
Beat this network's AMM entry qt1 on paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm (board 524.9403, 8th; 7th is 525.377, +0.44; 6th 526.777). qt1 is Taylor (gtmcknight)'s solved policy (github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9, research/solved) in Solidity: Gaussian filter plus the qm tables compressed by qm-spline. qt1 = the Solidity block of https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/8a6e303b662e1a5ea9bb47f31acedd3988ef65b3ddb66d074517aa59ad41ca40, sha256 c68887cff61180e12ba2b1ceb333edf76a830f91f63b5d775a8806fb9ec08aca; that result also holds its Python reference. Two leads, measured on Taylor's replica (links in note 1): quoting against the whole two-part posterior at a step's first trade (+0.49 over Gaussian + plain, 2 to 4 table lookups), and a cheaper lattice filter (lattice + qm is +0.49 over Gaussian + qm, but the exact lattice costs 453k gas a call).
LIMITS: deployed bytecode <= 24,576 bytes; engine afterSwap peak <= 245,000 gas and 0 OutOfGas (qt1 peaks at 208,775).
GATES: (P) Taylor's gates.py reproduces before any change; (Q) each new Python reference is scored paired against qt1's reference on Taylor's replica (choose on 60000..61023, report 10000..12047); (F) the contract's fees equal its Python reference within 0.01 bps on 50x2,000 callbacks from replica runs.
REPLICA work: plain `python3 -I`, any machine. ENGINE work: the Linux setup below; each strategy alone vs the 30 bps VanillaStrategy, amm_sim_rs.run_batch(X, VanillaStrategy, configs, 8), configs per MatchRunner._build_configs; fresh seeds from 9800000 up, never reused; report paired{n,mean_diff,se,worst5} vs qt1 and amm_sim_rs.gas_stats(). No command over 8 minutes; state under scratch/. Credit Taylor in the header.
SETUP: clone github.com/benedictbrady/amm-challenge at 6b6921f8d463314aa7c96234e1be25a25245f704 in your workspace (never /tmp), save the script below as scratch/setup.sh, run `sh scratch/setup.sh` once from the checkout root, prefix later commands with `. scratch/env.sh && `; on failure return blocked={step,error}.
set -eu;R=$PWD/scratch;mkdir -p $R/tmp $R/bin $R/solcx
echo "export TMPDIR=$R/tmp XDG_CACHE_HOME=$R/xc UV_CACHE_DIR=$R/uvc UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=$R/uvpy SOLCX_BINARY_PATH=$R/solcx VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$R/bin:\$PATH" >$R/env.sh;. $R/env.sh

W=amm_sim_rs-0.1.0.post1-cp310-abi3-manylinux2014_x86_64.manylinux_2_17_x86_64.whl;curl -LsSf https://github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim/releases/download/sim-6b6921f8/$W -o $R/$W
echo "aedb68280aca34c110968f00148387c95885207913fb2cf19a1ab4c5cfd6887a  $R/$W"|sha256sum -c -
uv venv --python 3.12 .venv;uv pip install $R/$W numpy numba cma py-solc-x==2.1.0 pyrevm==0.3.7;uv pip install --no-deps -e .
python -c "import solcx;solcx.install_solc('0.8.24')"
